# Collections case (`collections-case` v1)

A delinquent account in collections: arrears, stage, strategy and contact history.

**Group:** Retail banking · **Mnemonic:** `COLC` · **Identifiers:** `COLC-…` in `caseId`

Open one with `COLC <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: collections-case
version: 1
description: "A delinquent account in collections: arrears, stage, strategy and contact history."
match: { kind: collections-case, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Retail banking · Collections case, id: $.caseId }
strip:
  - { label: Customer, bind: $.customerName }
  - { label: Arrears, bind: $.arrears, fmt: amount2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Days past due, bind: $.daysPastDue, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Stage, bind: $.stage }
  - { label: Strategy, bind: $.strategy }
  - { label: Status, bind: $.status, tone: status }
panels:
  - id: contacts
    kind: ladder
    title: Contact history
    key: F2
    rows: $.contacts
    columns:
      - { label: Date, bind: "@.date", fmt: date }
      - { label: Channel, bind: "@.channel" }
      - { label: Outcome, bind: "@.outcome" }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.customer, 'customer')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
